review_text: My account was upgraded to a paid subscription without my intent. I cancelled and requested a refund after seeing the charge.
I cancelled auto-renew because I do not want to pay next month.
note: Cancellation alone does not prove an unexpected charge.

review_text: The free plan runs out of messages quickly and keeps asking me to upgrade.
The answers are often inaccurate and the assistant ignores simple instructions.
I cannot find the settings menu to change my preferences.
I received a free trial, but the product was not worth paying for.
note: Poor value is not proof of a billing problem.
